ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated primarily at the distal tips and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region in the central and basal areas; dense white mottling at both distal tips; scattered white pixel clusters across the medial surface of the right lobe; prominent white horizontal band near the leading edge of the left lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 45 to 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge of both lobes; peaks and valleys vary in amplitude between 5 and 15 pixels; edge appears jagged and discontinuous.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the posterior boundary of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small circular high-contrast white spots concentrated on the right lobe near the trailing edge; one distinct white ring-shaped feature located 150 pixels right of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, multi-directional white linear disruptions visible on the mid-to-outer region of the right lobe, resembling rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable circular white ring scar near the central notch on the right side; jagged, potentially traumatic irregularities on the distal trailing edges.
